PV.Session.Resumption.Text.text:p: The session adjourned on Thursday 18 June 2026 was resumed.

PV.Announcement.Text.text:p: The President announced that the different measures to make plenary more dynamic, more efficient and more engaging would continue to be tested during that part-session.

The President pointed out that the conduct witnessed in the Chamber during the previous part-session (aggressive chanting, jeering and filming of Members) was unacceptable and incompatible with the dignity of Parliament. She stressed that debates must always be based on mutual respect and on tolerance. She announced that appropriate action would be taken to ensure that such scenes would not occur again. She called on Members to ensure Parliament remained a place where everyone felt safe and where political disagreement could not justify intimidation.

PV.Statement.Text.text:p: The President made a statement to commemorate 31 years since the Srebrenica genocide. She reaffirmed Parliament’s commitment to peace, justice and reconciliation in Srebrenica and beyond.

She also made a statement on the devastating earthquakes that had recently struck Venezuela, killing thousands of people and leaving thousands more missing. The President praised the response from the EU, which, through the Civil Protection Mechanism, had mobilised aid to support relief and recovery efforts.
Parliament observed a minute’s silence in memory of all the victims.

PV.Approval.Text.text:h: 5Approval of the minutes of the previous sitting
PV.Approval.Text.text:p: The minutes of the previous sitting were approved.

PV.Deposit.Text.text:p: The competent Netherlands authorities had given notice of the election of Ufuk Kâhya to the European Parliament to replace Bas Eickhout with effect from 30 June 2026.
Parliament took note of his election.

Under Rule 3(2), until such time as his credentials had been verified or a ruling had been given on any dispute, and provided that he had previously made a written declaration stating that he did not hold any office incompatible with that of Member of the European Parliament, Ufuk Kâhya would take his seat in the European Parliament and on its bodies and would enjoy all the rights attaching thereto.

PV.Other.Text.text:p: On the basis of a unanimous proposal issued by the JURI Committee at its meeting of 23 June 2026 concerning Majbritt Birkholm and Csaba Bogdán, and at its meeting of 2 July 2026 concerning Viktor Weisz, Parliament verified the credentials and confirmed the mandates of Majbritt Birkholm with effect from 16 April 2026, and of Csaba Bogdán and Viktor Weisz with effect from 22 May 2026, in accordance with Rule 3(4).

Pursuant to Rules 10, 183 and 222 of the Rules of Procedure, and after taking into account the observations of the Member concerned, the President had decided to impose a penalty on Grzegorz Braun for his improper behaviour during the SEDE Committee meeting of 18 March 2026, which had harmed the dignity and reputation of Parliament. The President had also taken account of the recurrent nature of Grzegorz Braun’s disrespect of the standards of conduct.

The penalty consisted of the forfeiture of entitlement to the daily subsistence allowance for a period of two days, as well as a temporary suspension from participation in all the activities of the SEDE Committee for a period of 20 days on which the SEDE Committee would meet, including as a joint committee or in association with interparliamentary delegations, as of 16 June 2026.
